punchline: Oversharing and never sharing are the same problem pointing in opposite directions.
thirty_sec: Nedra Glover Tawwab describes three levels of boundaries. Porous ones let everyone in: oversharing, people-pleasing, trouble saying no. Rigid ones let no one in: never sharing, never asking for help, keeping everyone at a distance. Healthy boundaries mean sharing the right amount with the right people, and being able to say no and hear no. Most of us mix all three across different relationships.
question: Where are your boundaries too loose, and where have they become walls?
